CommunityApplications.Profile:
GarageStack is an open-source vehicle monitoring dashboard for MG / SAIC electric, plug-in hybrid, and hybrid vehicles. It connects to the MG iSmart cloud and stores all data locally in a single container -- no external database or MQTT broker required.
Features: live dashboard and remote commands, energy, fuel and efficiency statistics, a trip log with CSV export, a map with trip history, heatmap and OpenStreetMap overlays, Web Push notifications, single sign-on, and Home Assistant integration.
Support: https://github.com/joszz/garagestack/issues
